# Settings

Every key the app declares in `settings.json`: 21. Open the file with **Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)**; a key you leave out keeps its default, and a value the app cannot read is reported in the Problems panel and the default applies. A plugin adds its own keys as `<plugin id>.<key>`, which are not listed here.

## templatesFolder

A folder of templates searched before the built-in pack, or null for none.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string \| null` | `null` |

## queueFolder

The local queue folder (the parent of inbox, outbox and done), or null.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string \| null` | `null` |

## queueAutoRun

Render a task dropped into the queue inbox without being asked.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `false` |

## queueKinds

The file types each queue folder produces, by folder path.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `object` | `{}` |

## theme

The colour theme: a theme id, or { mode: "system" \| "light" \| "dark", light, dark }.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string \| object` | `{"mode":"system","light":"tyto-light","dark":"tyto-dark"}` |

## iconStrokeWidth

How thick the icons are drawn, from 0.75 to 2 (default 1.25).

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `number from 0.75 to 2` | `1.25` |

## statusBarItems

Which status bar items show, in order inside their side: leftArea, commandBar, vimMode, cursorPosition, tabKind, template, problems, explorer, queue, plugins, export, settings, bottomArea, rightArea.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `list of string` | `["leftArea","commandBar","vimMode","cursorPosition","tabKind","template","problems","explorer","queue","plugins","export","settings","bottomArea","rightArea"]` |

**Values of each entry**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"leftArea"` | Button that shows or hides the left area. |
| `"commandBar"` | Button that opens the command bar. |
| `"vimMode"` | Vim's mode badge and pending keys, while vim is on. |
| `"cursorPosition"` | Line and column of the caret, and the selection size. |
| `"tabKind"` | What the tab in front holds: brief, settings, preview… |
| `"template"` | The template the brief's frontmatter names. |
| `"problems"` | Problems count; toggles the problems panel. |
| `"explorer"` | Toggles the explorer panel. |
| `"queue"` | Toggles the queue panel. |
| `"plugins"` | Opens the plugins dialog. |
| `"export"` | Exports the brief in front. |
| `"settings"` | Opens settings.json. |
| `"bottomArea"` | Button that shows or hides the bottom area. |
| `"rightArea"` | Button that shows or hides the right area. |

## vimModeStyle

How the status bar shows vim's mode: 'badge' (Only the mode's name is coloured, as a badge. The default.), 'border' (A strip along the bar's top edge takes the mode's colour; the bar keeps its own.), 'bar' (The whole bar takes the mode's colour, with text chosen to read on it.)

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string` | `"badge"` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"badge"` | Only the mode's name is coloured, as a badge. The default. |
| `"border"` | A strip along the bar's top edge takes the mode's colour; the bar keeps its own. |
| `"bar"` | The whole bar takes the mode's colour, with text chosen to read on it. |

## indentGuides

Draw a vertical guide at each indent level in the editor (default true).

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `true` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `true` | A guide per indent level; the block holding the cursor darker. |
| `false` | No guides. |

## stickyScroll

Keep a block's head line pinned at the top of the editor while scrolling inside it (default true).

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `true` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `true` | The head line of the block at the top stays pinned; a click goes to it. |
| `false` | Nothing pinned. |

## formatBriefOnSave

Format a brief (Format Brief) every time it is saved (default false).

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `boolean` | `false` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `true` | Save fixes the indentation, trailing spaces and repeated blank lines first. A brief with a syntax error is saved as it is. |
| `false` | Save writes the brief exactly as it is. |

## tabSize

Spaces per indent level: what Tab inserts, the indent guides’ step and the indent Format Brief writes, from 1 to 8 (default 2).

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `integer from 1 to 8` | `2` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `2` | Two spaces per level, the indent the built-in examples use. |
| `4` | Four spaces per level. |

## briefColumns

How the editor tells the columns of a brief's "\|" lines apart: 'off', 'separator' (the default), 'alternate' or 'perColumn'.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string` | `"separator"` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"off"` | Nothing: a "\|" line is drawn as plain text. |
| `"separator"` | Each "\|" that splits a line in the function colour. The default. |
| `"alternate"` | The "\|" coloured, and every even column in the muted text colour. In some themes the muted colour barely differs from the text. |
| `"perColumn"` | The "\|" coloured, and the columns cycling through three colours. Some themes draw a column below comfortable reading contrast. |

## zoom

How far the whole window is zoomed, in steps of 20%, from -5 to 5 (default 0). Ctrl and =, Ctrl and - and Ctrl and 0 write it.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `integer from -5 to 5` | `0` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `0` | Actual size. |
| `1` | One step in: 120%. |
| `2` | Two steps in: 144%. |
| `-1` | One step out: 83%. |

## uiFontFamily

The face of the window's text outside the editor: menus, tabs, panels, the status bar, the preview's controls and the dialogs. Source Sans 3 is drawn for a name this machine does not have.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string` | `"Source Sans 3"` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"Source Sans 3"` | The face Tyto ships. The default. |

## uiFontSize

The size of the window's text outside the editor, in pixels, from 9 to 24 (default 14). Smaller and larger labels keep their proportion to it.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `integer from 9 to 24` | `14` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `14` | The default. |
| `16` | A little larger. |
| `18` | Larger; the tab strips grow to fit. |

## codeFontFamily

The face of the editor: briefs, settings and the template buffers. IBM Plex Mono is drawn for a name this machine does not have.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `string` | `"IBM Plex Mono"` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"IBM Plex Mono"` | The face Tyto ships. The default. |

## codeFontSize

The size of the editor’s text, in pixels, from 9 to 32 (default 14).

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `integer from 9 to 32` | `14` |

**Values**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `14` | The default. |
| `16` | A little larger. |
| `20` | Large. |

## fontSizes

A text size in pixels for one part of the window, over its base (uiFontSize or codeFontSize). An area left out follows its base. editor: The brief editor and the template buffers. json: The settings, keybindings and snippets tabs. completion: The editor's suggestion list. problems: The problems panel's rows. commandBar: The command bar (Ctrl+K) and its lists. titleBar: The window's title bar, up to 18; the native menus keep the system's text. tabs: The editor groups' tab strips, which grow to fit. paneHeaders: The breadcrumb row, a preview's bar and the panels' headers. statusBar: The status bar. queue: The queue panel's body. explorer: The explorer panel's tree.

| Type | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `object` | `{}` |

**Names of each member**

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"editor"` | The brief editor and the template buffers. Follows codeFontSize and codeFontFamily while unset. |
| `"json"` | The settings, keybindings and snippets tabs. Follows codeFontSize and codeFontFamily while unset. |
| `"completion"` | The editor's suggestion list. Follows codeFontSize and codeFontFamily while unset. |
| `"problems"` | The problems panel's rows. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"commandBar"` | The command bar (Ctrl+K) and its lists. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"titleBar"` | The window's title bar, up to 18; the native menus keep the system's text. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"tabs"` | The editor groups' tab strips, which grow to fit. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"paneHeaders"` | The breadcrumb row, a preview's bar and the panels' headers. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"statusBar"` | The status bar. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"queue"` | The queue panel's body. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
| `"explorer"` | The explorer panel's tree. Follows uiFontSize and uiFontFamily while unset. |
